# Failures

The failure a test returns, and skipping a test.

<h2 id="test-failure"><code>TestFailure</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct TestFailure {
    // private fields
}
```

Why a test did not pass. `Copy`.
A test fails with it through `fail` or `?`, and is counted as skipped rather than failed when it was made with
[`Skip`](/docs/api/test/failure#skip).

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Failure.rux#L14)

```rux
pub func Of(message: char8[..]) -> TestFailure
```

<h3 id="skip"><code>Skip</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Skip(reason: char8[..]) -> TestFailure
```

A skip, which the runner counts apart from failures, saying why the test did not run.

| Name     | Type        | Description        |
| -------- | ----------- | ------------------ |
| `reason` | `char8[..]` | why it was skipped |

**Returns**: the skip

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Test/Src/Failure.rux#L35)
